country_decisions: country.treasury.cash: the treasury reporting entities, forecast horizons, approved cash categories, reconciliation frequency, variance thresholds and escalation authority (none ship).
country.exec.finance.retention: retention, confidentiality, disclosure and access restrictions for public finance records (records owner and legal and privacy reviewers).

library.title: Propose a liquidity response
library.intro: Propose how the treasury responds to an expected shortfall, with the options considered.
library.authority: The finance authority the nation names for the finance slot under Who is responsible (authorityFor('finance')); the spending institution is named on each record and acts only for itself; never a ministry by name.
library.intended: Liquidity response: not built (no procedure carries a liquidity response yet; any borrowing is the public debt department's, not built).

policies.access.read_rule: canReadFinance() in lib/auth/roles.ts: officials of the finance authority, and of a spending institution for its own records; auditors with a purpose; every read of a payment in the access log
policies.access.others: Payee bank details are sealed and shown masked; no other institution reads them
policies.amounts.stated: response.amount: the amount the reporting official states

nation_values.decision: The variance above which an explanation is required and escalated (the nation's treasury rules); none ships.

deviations.what: Liquidity response: not built (no procedure carries a liquidity response yet; any borrowing is the public debt department's, not built).
deviations.why: The record type and its procedure are the nation's treasury configuration.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: cases change only under an approved procedure package; plan step I5

deviations.what: The official who records it comes from the signed-in session, never typed; their authority is the power the procedure step needs and the role roles.ts gives them
deviations.why: Who acted is the verified signed-in official.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Who acted: withOfficial() replaces any name in the request

deviations.what: The amount is what a person states (an institution's request or forecast, an invoice, the officials' proposed figure), typed as money with its currency and named in the form's amounts.stated policy; it is never a charge, and the amount that binds is the one the sealed decision and the register record
deviations.why: A request or forecast is a statement; only a decision of the officials the procedure names fixes an allocation, a commitment or a payment.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: rates, bands and tariffs come only from lib/law/rules.ts; plan step I5 (no amount typed into code)

deviations.what: No threshold, approval tier or limit, payment calendar, fiscal period, variance threshold, forecast horizon, quorum or deadline is typed: each is a named nation value (an approved rule in lib/law/rules.ts or a country rule set) checked by a binding rule, recorded as not performed and a publication blocker until the nation approves it; categories, purposes, outcomes and types the law decides are nation lists that ship empty
deviations.why: The field series Part 2: fiscal calendars, official values, budget authority and statutory deadlines are configured by each nation and approved by its authorized officials.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: rates, bands and tariffs come only from lib/law/rules.ts; never type a statutory rate, penalty or deadline into code or seed data

deviations.what: Changing a country configuration does not generate an impact assessment of the forms and open procedure packages it touches: the publication gates re-read the rules and lists in force each time they run, and a procedure version keeps what it was approved with until a new version is approved
deviations.why: No impact-assessment record exists on the platform yet (integration register 20.11).
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Integration register: a stand-in is listed with what connecting it for real takes

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it
